hypothesis: Past-cycle target statistics summarized over signal_stream document tokens may add a compact supervised lexical feature family that differs from word TF-IDF and sparse/NB representations. This is an association/prediction hypothesis, not a claim about token meaning or causation.
comparison_interpretation: The new Classification expert is deliberately fit on present-stream rows only; current controls were fit on their original supplied populations. Therefore candidate-control deltas jointly reflect representation and fit-population differences and cannot be attributed to token statistics alone. Missing-stream rows remain on the unchanged CB_MISSING route.

encoder.token_unit: Unigram document-presence: each normalized analyzer token counts at most once per report.
encoder.normalization: sklearn TfidfVectorizer unigram analyzer with lowercase and Unicode accent stripping.
encoder.training_order: All reports in cycle c are encoded before any target from cycle c is added. Each fitted training row may only use target labels from strictly earlier cycles. Validation rows use all labels from the corresponding past-only fit period.
encoder.regression_target_unit: threat_rank / 100 for token statistics; unchanged 0-100 target for regression estimator.

classification_policies.fit_population: Present-stream rows only, signal_stream non-missing and nonblank, cycles 47 through the cutoff. The expert is only routed for present streams; absent/blank streams remain on the original CB_MISSING expert.
classification_policies.initial_control: C2_B on present streams and original CB_MISSING expert on missing streams.
classification_policies.latest_control: Fixed 25% sparse-LGB + 75% C2_B present expert from the verified Optimization V3 sparse pilot; original CB_MISSING expert on missing streams.
classification_policies.direct_candidate: Use OrderedStatsBoost probability on present streams and preserve CB_MISSING on missing streams.
classification_policies.fixed_blend_candidate: Use 25% OrderedStatsBoost probability + 75% latest sparse25 control on present streams; preserve CB_MISSING exactly on missing streams.
classification_policies.advance_gate_vs_latest: Pooled primary-pilot OR pooled H12 Macro F1 improves, and no W1/W4/H12_E/H12_L view loses more than 0.01 Macro F1.

regression_policies.fit_population: All official Regression Train rows in cycles 47 through the cutoff.
regression_policies.control: Current three-component champion reconstructed from the original row-aligned V2 caches via scripts/optimization_v3_reg_diagnostics.py:_build_view.
regression_policies.advance_gate_for_fixed_blend: Pooled primary-pilot OR H12 MAE improves and the maximum MAE harm in W1/W4/H12_E/H12_L is at most 0.50.

fit_population.classification: signal_stream present and nonblank, cycles 47 through cutoff; present-only expert
fit_population.regression: all official Train rows, cycles 47 through cutoff

interpretation_limits: These are known Train-cycle development views reused in prior adaptive work, not an untouched holdout.
The token summaries describe past label associations and do not identify anonymous token semantics.
A model gain would not establish that individual tokens cause the target or generalize to official Test.
